event_chain.summary: Privilege abuse - exam questions leaked to students

summary: Assistant Professor Ashish Kumar Gupta of Shivalik College of Engineering, appointed as an external question-paper setter for Veer Madho Singh Bhandari Uttarakhand Technical University, allegedly shared exam questions with students through his institution's online portal and WhatsApp before the tests. An internal inquiry triggered by a complaint about the 'Machine Learning for Internet of Things' exam confirmed the leak and found a second compromised paper, 'Electromagnetic Field Theory'. The university cancelled both exams across 12 affiliated institutions and Gupta was arrested (reported July 2026).
